title: MahaVar: OOD Detection via Class-wise Mahalanobis Distance Variance under Neural Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2605.14413v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is a critical component for ensuring the reliability of deep neural networks in safety-critical applications. In this work, we present a key empirical observation: for in-distribution (ID) samples, class-wise Mahalanobis distances exhibit a pronounced sharp minimum structure, where the distance to the nearest class is small while distances to all other classes remain large, resulting in high variance across classes. In contrast, OOD samples tend to exhibit a less pronounced sharp minimum structure, producing comparatively lower variance across classes. We further provide a theoretical analysis grounding this observation in Neural Collapse geometry: under relaxed Neural Collapse assumptions on within-class compactness and inter-class separation, ID samples are shown to structurally exhibit high class-wise distance variance, offering a theoretical basis for its use as an OOD score. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.14413v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：分布外检测是确保深度神经网络在安全关键应用中可靠性的关键组成部分。在本工作中，我们提出了一个关键的经验观察：对于分布内样本，类间马氏距离呈现出明显的尖锐最小值结构，即样本到最近类的距离很小，而到所有其他类的距离依然很大，从而导致各类之间的高方差。相比之下，分布外样本往往表现出不那么明显的尖锐最小值结构，产生相对较低的类间方差。我们进一步基于神经坍缩几何提供了理论分析来支撑这一观察：在对类内紧凑性和类间分离性施加宽松神经坍缩假设的条件下，我们证明分布内样本在结构上表现出较高的类间距离方差，这为其作为分布外检测分数的使用提供了理论基础。受此启发……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现分布内样本的类间马氏距离方差显著高于分布外样本，并利用神经坍缩几何给出了理论证明，据此提出了一种基于类间马氏距离方差的新型分布外检测方法MahaVar。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that in-distribution samples exhibit significantly higher class-wise Mahalanobis distance variance than OOD samples, provides theoretical grounding via Neural Collapse geometry, and proposes MahaVar, a novel OOD detection method based on this variance.
